basis: For each fresh capped diagnostic, start from its matched P19 same-seed trial wall and add the extra cap tokens divided by that trial’s measured decode throughput. Add one measured P19 model-load wall. The upper/lower bounds are planning uncertainty multipliers, not confidence intervals. Natural stop shortens decode; prefill, long-context behavior, and shared load can change wall time.

per_case.uncertainty: Assumes the observed same-trial per-token decode rate continues. Natural stopping can shorten the run; long-context throughput/prefill and contention can vary.
